_comment: Token Steward defaults. Org admins: override any key by pointing TOKEN_STEWARD_CONFIG at a JSON file (deep-merged over this one), or fork this file. Prices are USD per 1M tokens, Anthropic first-party API list prices as of 2026-11. Update when pricing changes or if you buy through Bedrock/Vertex/an enterprise agreement.
_framing_comment: 'usage' (default): messages talk about tokens and your plan's session and weekly limits, which is what matters on Pro, Max, Team and seat-based Enterprise plans. 'dollars': messages quote API list-price cost and savings, for firms that pay per token (API keys, usage-based billing, Bedrock, Vertex).
_aliases_comment: Maps Claude Code model aliases (settings 'model', /model) to the model they currently resolve to. Keep in sync with your Claude Code version.
_tier_commands_comment: What we tell people to type to move to a tier.
_default_effort_comment: Effort a model runs at when nothing sets it explicitly. Used only when Token Steward cannot read the effort from the session.
_effort_output_multiplier_comment: Relative output-token volume (thinking + answer) per effort level, medium = 1.0. These are conservative planning assumptions used ONLY to estimate the effort component of savings. Run /token-steward:savings --calibration to compare against what your own sessions show, and tune here.

baseline._comment: Savings are measured against this reference configuration: 'what this work would have cost on the premium setup'. Shown to users in every savings message so the claim is transparent.

recommendations._comment: Suggested configuration per task class. Nudges fire only when the session is meaningfully above this.

nudge._mode_comment: 'advise' = never blocks, shows a tip. 'confirm' = for severe mismatches only, the first submission is held with an explanation; re-sending the same prompt goes through unchanged.

_right_sized_comment: A task counts as right-sized (thank-yous, weekly counts, milestones) only when it ran at least this many times lighter than the reference setup, estimated as for every comparison. 1.5 means Opus at medium effort (about 1.1x lighter than Opus at high) doesn't count; Sonnet or Haiku for the same work does.

upgrade._comment: Right-sizing goes both ways: when a request looks like complex, multi-step work on a light setup, suggest moving up. A first answer that is right costs less than several retries, and it shows people the tool is on their side.

celebrations._comment: A small celebration when someone's all-time savings cross a milestone (USD), and when they first act on a tip. The browser extension shows confetti; Claude Code shows a celebratory message. Seat-plan firms using the extension's 'allowance' framing celebrate right-sized task counts instead.

default_turn_tokens._comment: Used to estimate per-prompt savings in a nudge before this user has their own history.

telemetry._comment: Optional. If set, each completed turn's anonymous metrics record (no prompt or response text, ever) is POSTed as JSON to this URL. Leave empty to keep everything on the user's machine.

classifier._comment: Local, zero-cost heuristic. Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions. Weights: positive pushes toward 'complex', negative toward 'trivial'. Tune for your firm's work.
classifier._thresholds_comment: A task is only called trivial/routine when at least one 'light work' signal matched. Everything without clear evidence is 'general' and never nudged.
